The standard reduction: for each edge `(u,v)` in the source graph, add a new "edge vertex" `x_e` adjacent to both `u` and `v`. Any dominating set of the new graph must contain an endpoint of each original edge (to dominate `x_e`), so it yields a vertex cover. Conversely a vertex cover dominates all edge-vertices and all non-isolated original vertices.
